title: Dive in
summary: The camera dives into a detail of A; B opens inside it, a ring breaks outward, B's parts rise into focus.
signature: diveIn(a, b, p, { duration, target, depth })

params.name: duration
params.description: length of the transition in seconds; springs use it to keep their feel

params.name: target
params.description: CSS selector of the detail to dive into

notes: The camera dives into a detail of A (`target`); B opens inside it as it fills the slot, a ring breaks outward, B's parts rise into focus.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
`target` is a selector inside A (default [data-part="media"]); a round detail reads best.
